siglum.description: The siglum proposed for a conspectus; an edition may use another.

category.description: What the carrier is. A papyrus is a manuscript with papyrus as its material; archives written before 3 October 2026 may have "papyrus" here.

format.description: A manuscript's format; null for other categories.

sourceAuthor.description: For an indirect source: the author who quotes or reports the text.

sourceWork.description: For an indirect source: the work in which the text is quoted.

material.description: One of papyrus, parchment, paper, palm-leaf, birch-bark, leather, wood, wax-tablet, ostracon, clay, stone, metal, bone, textile, plaster; or a free text for another material.

hands.description: The hands of the witness; corrections in its transcripts name them by id.
